title: Cargo token redaction misses --token=<value> form
reasoning: The command logger redacts only the split argv shape `--token <value>`. Cargo/clap-style flags also commonly accept `--token=<value>`, and that entire token is currently pushed to the log unchanged. A publish or login invocation using the equals form can therefore leak the secret into CI logs even though this helper explicitly tries to keep token values out of command output.
reproduction: Call `cargoCommand("publish", "--token=secret-value")`; the logged command includes `--token=secret-value` because `redactArgs` only matches an exact `--token` token followed by a separate value.
recommendation: Extend redaction to recognise `--token=<value>` and emit `--token=***`; consider centralising secret flag handling for both split and equals forms.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests cover cargo path classification only; there are no tests for `cargoCommand` logging or `redactArgs` secret handling.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a cargo utility test that exercises the redaction helper or a captured `cargoCommand` log for both `["--token", "secret"]` and `["--token=secret"]`, asserting the secret string is absent.
minimumFixScope: Update `redactArgs` in `src/utils/cargo.ts` and add focused coverage for both supported token flag shapes.
